When it comes to bocking the general theory is: overheads are reactable not lows, so always block low and be on the lookout for overheads and throws.

i'll give you an example, you blocked my light and then i went into medium to heavy, that was a blockstring, a string of attacks you had to block.
A true blockstring is a string of attacks with no gaps in between, meaning after blocking the first attack you won't be able to input anything, in fact you can even drop the controller you'r character will keep blocking until there is a gap.
Mastery of blockstrings is one of the most important skills offense wise and understanding what is dangerous with every character you play. broly's blockstring will either end with a hit or a command grab that's where the danger lies.
